Evidence documents

To keep the marketplace trustworthy, please upload documents that prove your shop is genuine - for example a business registration, tax identification (TIN), a lease or utility bill for your shop location, your government ID, or photos of past work. At least one document is required.

How selling works

Four simple steps from application to your first sale.

Step 1 Apply

Submit your vendor application with your shop name and contact details. Applications are reviewed by an administrator.

Step 2 Get verified

You'll see your status right here. Once approved, your shop goes live on the marketplace.

Step 3 List products

Add items with a photo, price, category, genre and description. Manage them all from your catalogue.

Step 4 Sell & earn

The community buys from your shop and earns reward points. Track stock and grow your catalogue over time.
